text: ここは　たちいり　きんし　はいって　くんな！

structure.jp: ここは　たちいり　きんし

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: てくる after a verb says the action moves toward the speaker. くんな is a rough slurred くるな. はいって　くんな = 'don't come in here'.

patterns.name: 〜な (prohibition)
patterns.explanation: な right after the plain form of a verb is a blunt 'don't'. くん is くる said roughly. くんな = 'don't come'.
